content.thinking: I'm adjusting the fix so the reason clause is dropped and it instead states that no code fix is looked for, keeping the rest as it is.

input.overview: On io-shop, account pages failed to load for shoppers whose page asked for their saved card. This lasted at least {duration}. The cause was IO Payments Ltd, the outside payment company that the shop asks for a shopper's saved card. It started rejecting those requests, and every time a request failed, the account page failed too. At the worst minute, {peak_error_rate} of requests were failing. Argus estimates that this cost the shop at least {customer_loss} in takings. Nobody on call was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus took no action to end it, because the failure is in a service another company runs and nothing Argus can do reaches it. Its recommended step is to ask IO Payments Ltd to restore io-pay, and no code fix is being looked for. That step has not been taken.
